title: Skill author building a SKILL.md skill for Claude Desktop
prompt: I'm authoring a Claude Code skill (SKILL.md) that codifies my code-review workflow. No external dependencies, just the skill markdown. Will install into ~/.claude/skills.
expected_notes: Goal 'build_skill', target 'claude-code' or 'claude-desktop'. Most server-y layers (FS, Git, Data, Code-exec) should be skipped. Method-skill layer might surface code-review skills. Should NOT pick MCP servers as primary anywhere.
